perCase.note:
Not on record: The scent profile or fragrance notes of the lavender candle (e.g., 'fresh floral', 'earthy', 'sweet') — record what specific fragrance description the owner would use.
Not on record: The candle's weight or size (e.g., grams or ml) — record the net weight or volume of the product.
Not on record: Any return or exchange policy — record whether returns or exchanges are accepted and under what conditions.
Removed "The customer's candle journey has started." — it says something about the reader's own order or booking, and nothing here knows who is reading it.
Removed "Handcrafted goodness is being delivered to the customer." — it says something about the reader's own order or booking, and nothing here knows who is reading it.
Removed "The candles are made from pure soy wax." — Fact says 'soy wax only' but not 'pure' soy wax—purity is more specific than the fact..
Removed "The candles are made from pure soy wax." — Fact says 'soy wax only' but not 'pure' soy wax—purity is more specific than the fact..

Not on record: What is the burn time of a typical or competing candle of the same size, so a comparison claim can be made? Record as: 'A standard [size] candle of comparable type burns for [X] hours.'
Not on record: Which specific candle product(s) does the 40-hour burn time apply to — Lavender, Rose, or both? Record as: 'The 40-hour burn time applies to [product name(s)].'
Not on record: What is the wax weight or candle size (e.g. grams or oz) that achieves the 40-hour burn? Record as: 'The [X]g / [X]oz candle burns for 40 hours.'
Removed "The candles are cleaner than ordinary candles." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "The candles burn longer than ordinary candles." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "The candles are consistent from batch to batch." — nothing on record can support a capability claim.
Removed "The candles produce less smoke than ordinary candles." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "The candles have fragrance that lasts 40 hours." — The fact states 40 hours burn time, not that fragrance lasts 40 hours. These are different claims..

Left out: Name the service being welcomed — anchors the email to the right treatment. — a availability claim needs a record that can establish "policy", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Left out: Set expectations: a hair wash happens before the treatment is applied — useful prep info for the welcome email. — a process claim needs a record that can establish "process", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Not on record: Appointment booking / confirmation details: the email needs a way for the client to confirm, reschedule or contact the salon — no record covers a booking link, phone number, address or contact method.
Not on record: Aftercare instructions: a welcome email typically tells the client what to do (or avoid) after the treatment — no record covers post-treatment care guidance.
Not on record: Stylist or staff name: personalising the email with who will perform the treatment is common practice — no record names the assigned stylist.
Removed "This treatment is safe" — nothing on record can support a safety claim.
Removed "This treatment is completely safe" — nothing on record can support a safety claim.
Removed "There are no hidden charges for this treatment" — Fact states the confirmed price is given to avoid surprises, but does not state there are no hidden charges..

Left out: Name the flagship ammonia-free service so readers know what is on offer. — a availability claim needs a record that can establish "policy", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Left out: Briefly describe the treatment process (hair wash first, then treatment) to build trust and transparency. — a process claim needs a record that can establish "process", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Not on record: Which specific product range or brand is used for the ammonia-free treatments? The owner should record the product name(s) so copy can be more specific.
Not on record: Are there other ammonia-free services beyond the keratin treatment (e.g., colour, smoothening)? The owner should record a list of all ammonia-free services offered.
Removed "This product contains no ammonia." — Fact is about the business's practice, not about a specific product's composition..
Removed "This product contains no ammonia." — Fact is about the business's practice, not about a specific product's composition..

Not on record: Automatic monthly rebooking policy: Record whether the business has a confirmed, active system that automatically rebooks clients every month — e.g. 'We automatically rebook every client on a fixed monthly schedule without requiring them to contact us.'

Not on record: The welcome email has no brand name or business name on record — the owner should record: 'Business name is [Name].'
Not on record: There is no tagline or brand story on record — the owner should record: 'Our brand story / founding reason is [one sentence].'
Not on record: There is no record of what the ghee is made from (e.g. A2 cow milk, buffalo milk) — the owner should record: 'Desi ghee 500ml is made from [source milk].'
Not on record: There is no record of shelf life or storage instructions for the product — the owner should record: 'Desi ghee 500ml shelf life is [X months], store [condition].'
Not on record: There is no record of the offer code string for FIRST10 — the owner should record: 'The coupon code to apply for the 10% first-order discount is [CODE].'
Removed "The ghee is made slowly and carefully." — No fact states the process is slow or careful; hand-churned and Bilona method do not necessarily entail slowness or carefulness..
Removed "The ghee is made slowly and carefully." — No fact states the process is slow or careful; hand-churned and Bilona method do not necessarily entail slowness or carefulness..

You asked for 20% Diwali discount. Your records say The only recorded offer is FIRST10 — 10% off. No 20% Diwali offer exists in the records. — change the record, or I write it without that.
Left out: The business wants to promote a 20% Diwali discount — but no record supports a 20% offer; only a 10% offer (FIRST10) exists in the records. — no record was cited for this, so there is nothing to check it against.
Not on record: The Diwali discount percentage and its promo code or conditions (e.g., minimum order, validity dates) need to be recorded before the email can state them.
Removed "The business delivers hand-churned goodness to the customer's door." — nothing on record can support a capability claim.
Removed "The bilona method is slow and careful." — Approved facts describe the bilona method but do not state that it is slow and careful..
Removed "The bilona process is slow and careful, just as it has always been done." — Approved facts describe the bilona process but do not state that it is slow and careful, nor that it has always been done this way..

Not on record: What animal's milk is used (e.g. desi cow, buffalo) and is it A2? — Record the breed/milk type so the email can state it as a fact.
Not on record: Where is the ghee made / sourced from? — Record the village, farm or region so the email can ground the story in a real place.
Not on record: What is the shelf life or batch size of the product? — Record the figure so the email can set accurate expectations.
Removed "Ghee has been prepared using the traditional churning method in Indian homes for generations." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "The ghee that arrives in the customer's kitchen is genuinely artisan ghee." — nothing on record can support a capability claim.
Removed "The ghee is not made by industrial machines." — Absence of mention of industrial machines does not entail they are not used; Rule 2 applies..
Removed "Every batch of ghee is handcrafted." — Approved facts describe the process but do not specify 'every batch' is handcrafted; more specific than the fact..
Removed "The ghee is not factory-produced." — Absence of mention of factory production does not entail it is not factory-produced; Rule 2 applies..
